messages.subject: Fwd: Lavaan multilevel mediation
parts:
Essentially, I am trying to model and see if additional mediation paths explain the outcome variable better, and explain what share of variance.

The outcome variable is ordinal, it can be 3,5,7,11,and 13. All a-level variables are scores of a Likert-scale measure, ranging from 0 to 2, which can be treated as continuous. All b,c,d- level variables are demographic variables, including sex (binary), PCA scores of SES, etc.
I would really appreciate any suggestions, especially on the difference between adding parameters or not (as that changed degree of freedom), the correctness of my model codes, and available indices to evaluate the contribution of each variable (mediating paths) to explain the vriance of the outcome variable.
